description: LITERATURE-GROUNDED negation ladder for dermoscopy. Cue terms verbatim from Panicek & Hricak (AJR 2016) certainty lexicon and NegEx/ConText (Chapman 2001; Harkema 2009).

present: findings consistent with melanoma on dermoscopy
probable: findings probably representing melanoma on dermoscopy
possible: melanoma cannot be excluded on dermoscopy

historical: history of melanoma, resolved on dermoscopy
